description: This file defines the PartitionService interface for managing partition resolution, service discovery, and topology changes within the Thingsboard server queue discovery module.

classes.name: PartitionService
classes.description: Interface for partition resolution, service discovery, and topology management in the queue system.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the partition info for a given service type, queue, tenant, and entity, with optional partition parameter.

methods.name: resolveAll
methods.description: Resolves all partition info for a given service type, queue, tenant, and entity.

methods.name: isMyPartition
methods.description: Checks if the specified entity belongs to the current service's partition.

methods.name: isSystemPartitionMine
methods.description: Checks if the system partition is owned by the current service.

methods.name: getMyPartitions
methods.description: Returns the list of partitions owned by the current service for a given queue key.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Retrieves the topic name for a given queue key.

methods.name: recalculatePartitions
methods.description: Recalculates partitions based on current and other services' topology information.

methods.name: getAllServiceIds
methods.description: Returns all active service IDs for a given service type.

methods.name: getAllServices
methods.description: Returns all service info objects for a given service type.

methods.name: getOtherServices
methods.description: Returns service info objects for services other than the current one for a given service type.

methods.name: evictTenantInfo
methods.description: Removes tenant information from cache or state.

methods.name: countTransportsByType
methods.description: Counts the number of transports of a specific type.

methods.name: updateQueues
methods.description: Updates queue configurations based on provided messages.

methods.name: removeQueues
methods.description: Removes queues based on provided delete messages.

methods.name: removeTenant
methods.description: Removes tenant data from the system.

methods.name: isManagedByCurrentService
methods.description: Checks if a tenant is managed by the current service.

methods.name: resolvePartitionIndex
methods.description: Resolves the partition index for an entity ID or key within a number of partitions.
